name: University Teaching Hospital of Kigali (CHUK)
who_qualifies: People referred for specialist care in Kigali.
how_to_apply: Go to the casualty or outpatient desk, or arrive with a referral letter.

name: Rwanda Biomedical Centre
who_qualifies: National programmes; ask your local health centre.
how_to_apply: Ask a community health worker or district hospital about current campaigns.

name: King Faisal Hospital Kigali
who_qualifies: Patients who can book oncology and diagnostic services.
how_to_apply: Call the hospital switchboard or visit the outpatient department.

name: Butaro Cancer Centre of Excellence (Kigali liaison)
who_qualifies: People who need cancer treatment; many are referred from district hospitals.
how_to_apply: Ask your district hospital for a referral. This Kigali pin is a placeholder liaison point.

name: Kacyiru Health Centre
who_qualifies: People living nearby, including Mutuelle de Santé holders.
how_to_apply: Bring your Mutuelle card or national ID to the reception desk.
